units.source_text: 二条院殿内的人们也都担心公子的病况，大家非常狼狈，坐立不安。

en.t: The people within the Nijo residence were also worried about the young lord's condition, and everyone was badly flustered and unable to sit or stand at ease.

units.source_text: 宫中派来的问病使者，穿梭似地络绎不绝。

en.t: Messengers sent from the palace to inquire after his illness came and went without cease.

units.source_text: 源氏公子闻知父皇如此为他操心，觉得诚惶诚恐，只得勉强振作，感谢圣恩。

en.t: When Prince Genji heard that his imperial father was so worried about him, he felt deeply humbled and afraid, and could only force himself to rally and express gratitude for the imperial favor.

units.source_text: 左大臣也非常关怀，每日来二条院问病，照拂无微不至。

en.t: The Minister of the Left was also deeply concerned, coming every day to Nijo to ask after him and tending to him with the greatest care.

units.source_text: 大约是各方眷顾周到之故，公子在二十几天重病之后，果然渐渐复健，没有留下什么毛病。

en.t: Perhaps because care from every side was so thorough, after more than twenty days of grave illness the prince gradually recovered and was left with no lasting ailment.

units.source_text: 到了身蒙不洁满三十天的时候，公子已经起床，禁忌也已解除，情知父皇盼待心切，便在这天入宫参见，又赴宫中值宿处淑景舍小憩。

en.t: By the time the thirty days of ritual impurity had passed, the prince was already out of bed and the taboos had been lifted; knowing how eagerly his imperial father awaited him, he entered the palace that day to pay his respects, then went to his palace lodging, Shigeisa, for a short rest.

units.source_text: 回邸时左大臣用自己的车子迎送，并详细叮嘱病后种种禁忌。

en.t: When he returned to his residence, the Minister of the Left used his own carriage to escort him and carefully instructed him about the various restrictions after illness.

units.source_text: 源氏公子一时觉得如梦初醒，仿佛重生在一个新世界里了。

en.t: For a time Prince Genji felt as if he had just awakened from a dream, as though he had been reborn into a new world.

units.source_text: 到了九月二十日，病体已经痊愈，面容消瘦了许多，风姿却反而艳丽了。

en.t: By the twentieth day of the ninth month, his illness had fully healed; his face had grown much thinner, yet his bearing seemed all the more radiant.

units.source_text: 他还是常常沉思冥想，有时呜咽哭泣。

en.t: Still, he often sank into deep thought, and at times sobbed aloud.
Some of those who saw him found it strange;
others said, "Could a spirit have possessed him?"
